title: A city you can reprogram
summary: Named source, typed modules, safe version replacement and reclaiming inside the Brainfuck programming language, demonstrated by a native delivery city. Final visual and publication verification remains in progress.
commitConvention: Record the final implementation candidate, metadata-only closure, release tag and deployed artifact separately. Build001 is immutable.
humanInterventions: Owner provided the challenge and selected concept1. No human production code or repairs.

verification.selfAudit: Same Astra author; not an independent audit.

knownLimitations: 16-bit wrapping arithmetic, fixed capacities and explicit source length
Four module records; six version arenas; one rollback root per module
Live dependencies and pins can prevent reclamation
Resident general Thread code/dictionary remain monotonic
Module profile is pure and typed; not all general Thread words are permitted
Single execution stream; no collisions, traffic, server or cloud persistence
Module serial65535 refuses further publication rather than wrapping
General Thread developer access can corrupt guest state

Measured native cold steps take seconds; interpolation is presentation only
Finite checks and sole-author review are not an independent proof
